trial_court: Court of Civil Judge-01, Shahdara District, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi, Civil Suit No: 9954/2016
case_name: Shonal Gupta vs Pravir Ganguli And Others
facts_of_case: The parties were close friends. The defendant requested a loan from the plaintiff and received Rs.3,50,000/- which he promised to return. The suit seeks recovery of Rs.1,77,000/- (including principal amount of Rs.1,50,000/- + Rs.27,000/- interest) along with interest @ 24% per annum.

legal_principles.principle: A court has no territorial jurisdiction to entertain a suit if the defendant is residing or works for gain at a place outside its territorial jurisdiction.
legal_principles.held: that as per his own claim, the plaintiff has not made Mr. Vijay Aggarwal a party to the present suit and that in view of aforesaid stated facts, the suit of the plaintiff is false and frivolous and same is liable to be dismissed.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot claim relief in a court where it has not made necessary parties to the suit.
legal_principles.held: that the suit of the plaintiff is false and frivolous and same is liable to be dismissed.

outcome.final_order: The court passed a decree in favour of the plaintiff and against the defendant for Rs.1,83,000/- with interest @ 24% per annum from the date of institution till realization.
